steps.what: Read the diet order for these special meals.
Organize and develop special meals such as low-cholesterol or chemical-free meals.
Analyze and test those special meals by tasting them.
Prepare the special meals in the kitchen.

tasks.design: She reads the diet order, organizes and develops the special meal, tastes it, and prepares it in the kitchen. She still opens the order. No nutrient listing is produced, and no alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: The diet need and the taste of the meal are things she has to judge herself.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new develops or cooks the special meal for her.
tasks.still_hard: A meal she has not tasted can still be wrong for that person.
tasks.human_edge: She can change the meal because she tasted it.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still reads the order, develops the special meal, tastes it, and prepares it.

reach.task: cook the special meal she specified
reach.learn: The meal is one she tasted, not a generated recipe.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: she still reads the diet order, develops the special meal, tastes it, and prepares it. No tool is added.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
This performance is one low-cholesterol meal. A chemical-free meal uses the same reading, developing, tasting, and preparing. One episode is one meal.
She still opens and reads the diet order. No listing replaces that reading. She does not file a recipe. Preparing the meal is kitchen work, not a send.
No model writes a recipe. No alert is raised. Telling the person what is on the plate is not this task.
unknowns: Whether telling the person the meal contents sits on another task.
research_questions: Who else may change the meal after she has tasted it.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On one low-cholesterol meal she reads the diet order, organizes and develops it, analyzes it by tasting, and prepares it, and none of those steps is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read sanitation and safety procedures for the food service facilities.
Decide the menu development, budgeting, and planning that assist this operation.
Advise food service managers on establishment and evaluation of the nutrition programs.
Advise organizations on the same sanitation and safety points.

tasks.design: She reads the sanitation and safety procedures, decides the points, and says them. The food service manager is a colleague. The organization is outside her employer, and that talk files nothing. No alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: The facility and the people in the room are something she has to judge herself.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new reads the procedures or gives the advice for her.
tasks.still_hard: A hazard she did not see stays out of the advice.
tasks.human_edge: She can say only what she judged from the procedures and the kitchen.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still reads the procedures and advises the manager and the organization herself.

reach.task: run the kitchen after her advice
reach.learn: The points are what she said about sanitation, not a generated note.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: she reads the procedures and advises the manager and the organization herself. No tool is added.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
This performance is one visit. She advises the food service manager, a colleague, and a community organization outside her employer. One episode is one visit.
Both talks are spoken. No advice version is written or sent, so neither talk is gated. The manager talk stays inside the organisation.
She still opens and reads the procedures. No listing replaces that reading. No alert is raised. A written advice note is not this task.
unknowns: Whether a written advice note is required on another task.
research_questions: Who in the kitchen acts on the points after she has spoken.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On one visit she reads the sanitation procedures, decides the points, advises the food service manager, and advises the organization, and none of those steps is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the prices for food, equipment, and supplies.
Decide the amounts for equipment and supplies.
Prepare budgets for food, equipment, and supplies as budget v1.
File budget v1 for the food, equipment, and supplies.
Administer the budgets for equipment and supplies.

tasks.design: She reads the prices, decides the amounts, writes budget v1 herself, and files that version. Later she administers it by allowing spend that stays inside it. No order is sent, and no alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: The prices and the amounts are something she has to read and judge herself.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new writes or files the budget for her.
tasks.still_hard: A price she did not read can still make the budget wrong.
tasks.human_edge: She can file only the amounts she chose, and she can refuse a spend that breaks them.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still reads the prices, writes the budget, files it, and administers it.

reach.task: request equipment and supplies against the filed budget
reach.learn: The amounts are ones she wrote from prices she read.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: she reads the prices, writes the budget, files it, and administers it. No tool is added.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
This performance is one food budget for equipment and supplies. One episode is one budget.
She writes budget v1 herself. That writing step is not gated. On the file step she checks that budget v1 states the amounts she chose. Filing is inside the organisation.
Administering is her decision that a spend stays inside the filed budget. She does not send an order to an outside supplier in this task.
She still opens and reads the prices. No listing replaces that reading. No alert is raised.
unknowns: Whether a purchase from an outside supplier sits on another task.
research_questions: Who else may change the filed budget after she has filed it.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On one food budget she reads the prices, decides the amounts, prepares budget v1, files it, and administers it, and none of those steps is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the question for this nutrigenomic or nutrigenetic research.
Decide how she will plan that study.
Write protocol v1 for the nutrigenomic or nutrigenetic research.
File protocol v1 once she has written it.
Conduct the nutrigenomic or nutrigenetic research.
Evaluate the nutrigenomic or nutrigenetic research.

tasks.design: She reads the question, decides the plan, writes protocol v1 herself, and files that version. She then conducts the study and evaluates it. No results are sent, and no alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: The question and the study results are something she has to judge herself.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new writes the protocol or runs the study for her.
tasks.still_hard: A result she did not see stays out of the evaluation.
tasks.human_edge: She can file only the protocol she wrote, and she can evaluate only the study she conducted.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still plans the study, writes and files the protocol, conducts the research, and evaluates it.

reach.learn: The protocol is one she wrote for this study.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: she reads the question, writes the protocol, conducts the study, and evaluates it. No tool is added.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
This performance is one nutrigenomic study. A nutrigenetic study uses the same reading, writing, filing, conduct, and evaluation. One episode is one study.
She writes protocol v1 herself. That writing step is not gated. On the file step she checks that protocol v1 states the plan she chose. Filing is inside the organisation.
Conducting the study writes nothing new. Sending the protocol to an outside ethics board, and sending results out, are not this task.
She still opens and reads the question. No listing replaces that reading. No model writes the protocol. No alert is raised.
unknowns: Whether an outside ethics board must receive the protocol on another task.
research_questions: Who else may change the filed protocol after she has filed it.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On one nutrigenomic study she reads the question, decides the plan, writes protocol v1, files it, conducts the research, and evaluates it, and none of those steps is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.
